answer.text: Use engine oil grade 10W40 API SN, JASO MA2, semi synthetic.
For an oil change with a new oil filter, the refill amount is 2.1 L.

watchouts.text: Using the wrong oil grade will reduce the life of the moving parts and seriously affect performance.

disclaimers.text: The manual says the capacity values are approximate and the actual capacity will vary.

watchout_review.reason: The wrong oil grade warning is not given in the answer lines and is cited by the watchout.
